answer: Idena's validation ceremony is the gate: every two weeks, all members solve six FLIP image puzzles live inside a two-minute window, and one human can only sit in one ceremony at a time. A new identity needs an invitation from a validated member, so fake accounts grow along a vine of invitations tracing back to a real person. Each ceremony opens on a quartz-timed clock, and falcon-eyed reviewers flag identical solving patterns; a farm faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 humans online at the same minute, while one caught puppet burns the inviter's stake too.
